label: Actual esse CAUSE_2 is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1, from actual grounding
description: If c, distinct from the actual concretum x, causes x's esse, the OPEN esse-cause bridge makes c concrete, existing at w and a ground of x under the profile's selected relation; then c and x are both actual concreta related by grounding, so the OPEN grounding-to-priority bridge makes c simply prior to x. The second bridge's actuality antecedent for c is supplied by the first bridge's output. No dependence-for-being, dependence-to-grounding or possible-separation premise occurs. Each bridge is needed (Control.OmitEsseGround, Control.OmitGroundingPriority) and both hold jointly with a nonvacuous instance (Control.Witness). Conditional consequence only; neither bridge is established.
